geometry.camera: fixed native close view; shared projection for all layers

appearance.gradeMode: one approved fixed profile for compatible clip/scene family
appearance.sourceLight: baked into generated RGB; warm frontal appearance is a visual inference, not a measured light rig

pipeline.automatic: Validate source hash, dealer ID, dimensions, fps, anchors and model/task provenance.
pipeline.gate: Different source bytes require fresh QA.

pipeline.automatic: Compare camera, contact line, shoe outlet and work area with the chosen scene profile.
pipeline.gate: Moved shoe, higher rail or changed viewpoint require recalibration.

pipeline.automatic: Apply approved key/despill and object-mask recipe; inspect dark and light control backgrounds.
pipeline.gate: Reject missing fingers, eroded sleeves, halos or temporal chatter instead of hiding them with global blur.

pipeline.automatic: Measure reference ROIs, propose a fixed exposure/color profile, then use that same profile through the clip family.
pipeline.gate: Approval of a matched-frame comparison; no frame-by-frame brightness chasing.

pipeline.automatic: Compose table, source-derived hand shadow, replacement card and visible hand matte in consistent order.
pipeline.gate: No duplicate paper, slipping grip, disappearing landed cards or covered hand pixels.

pipeline.automatic: Render game-supplied rank/suit on a two-sided surface with shared UV deformation and restrained specular response.
pipeline.gate: No RNG/game rules here; held deformation must match observed grip; land flat and stay fixed.

pipeline.automatic: Compare raw start/end, face/hand regions and motion around every join.
pipeline.gate: Appearance drift at 6/12/15 seconds is an open failure. Color grading cannot correct facial anatomy/texture drift.

pipeline.automatic: Keep one-to-one 30 fps frame mapping, shared portrait transform, hashes and original outputs.
pipeline.gate: Visual motion approval and final scene approval remain explicit before Main activation.

compatible: alternative felt color/texture on same plane
brighter or darker room within a validated lighting family
requiresNewReview: raised chip tray crossing arm path
larger zoom-out exposing unrecorded body pixels
sceneVariants.chipTray: Optional scene asset. It may cover a torso boundary only if its height and position are physically plausible and every hand/card path remains visible. It cannot repair face drift or regenerate missing forearm pixels.
sceneVariants.shoe: Still baked into original dealer footage. New material rendering does not make it independently swappable.

automationBoundary: Most repeatable measurements and approved transforms can be automated. New geometry, incompatible lighting and generative anatomy failures require review or a targeted new source.
